App was broken, walks right (6 walks): contents-for-several, copies-share-choice, copy-own-color, chrome-says-labels, styled-row, picker-controls. Since 5a81d5a3 (system segmented control) two rows collapsed into dropdowns: the colour picker's Shades|Related|Document|Recent (a 'Shades v' dropdown) and a Mixed Arrangement's Free|Stack|Grid (an EMPTY dropdown). Cause 1: SwiftUI hands .controlSize(.small) to the NSSegmentedControl before updateNSView, so the font-on-size-change guard never fired and every small row drew 13pt words (debug-measured: size=small font=13). Cause 2: the system pads each word ~18pt; Mixed Arrangement gets 113pt, asks 133pt. Fix: font follows size on its own check; new PhotonzCore SegmentRoom (tested) adds a tight step (word + 10pt, spare shared) before the dropdown. Photographed: all four swatch words whole, Free|Stack|Grid whole beside Mixed.

Walks wrong, app moved on (2): menu-checkmarks-walk, panel-name-walk. Their ⇧⌘H trick stopped working on 2026-09-26 when walk windows stopped taking key, so the View menu read frozen. Fix: front:true in their setup (they photograph open menus, so they already needed the Mac to themselves). The harness's frozen-menu failure now says front:true instead of the dead History advice.
